mapper.select: SELECT scm10_dev_id AS dev_id , scm10_sr_id AS sr_id , scm10_person_id AS person_id , scm10_start_date AS start_date , scm10_due_date AS due_date , scm10_note AS note , scm10_reg_date AS reg_date , regexp_replace(regexp_replace(scm10_note, '<[^>]*>', '', 'g'), E'&#[0-9]+;|&\\w+;', '', 'g') AS arrange_note , f_emp_kor_nm(scm10_person_id) AS person_nm , scm01_sr_date AS sr_date , scm01_sr_no AS sr_no , f_cdnm('SystemCode', scm01_system_cd, 1, f_sysdate()) AS system_nm , scm01_requestor||CASE WHEN scm01_corp_id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '('||f_get_corp_nm(scm01_corp_id)||')' END AS requestor , ( SELECT scm11_result_date::date FROM scm11_dev_step WHERE scm11_dev_id = scm10_dev_id AND scm11_result_cd LIKE '1' ORDER BY scm11_dev_step_seq DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS result_date , f_get_dev_status(scm10_dev_id) AS dev_step_result , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm13_dev_program WHERE scm13_dev_id = scm10_dev_id ) AS dev_program_cnt , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE ( sys10_parent_id IN ( SELECT scm11_dev_step_id FROM scm11_dev_step WHERE scm11_dev_id = scm10_dev_id ) OR sys10_parent_id = scm10_dev_id ) ) AS file_cnt FROM scm10_dev INNER JOIN scm01_sr ON scm10_sr_id = scm01_sr_id WHERE scm10_sr_id = #{srId} ORDER BY scm10_reg_date DESC, scm10_dev_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm10_dev WHERE scm10_dev_id = #{devId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm10_dev (scm10_dev_id, scm10_sr_id, scm10_person_id, scm10_note, scm10_reg_date) VALUES (#{devId}, #{req.srId}, #{req.personId}, #{req.note}, #{req.regDate})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm11_dev_step WHERE scm11_dev_id = #{devId}

SELECT scm12_dev_step_rule_id AS dev_step_rule_id , scm12_dev_step_seq AS dev_step_seq , scm12_dev_step_cd AS dev_step_cd , f_cdnm('DevStepCode', scm12_dev_step_cd, 1, f_sysdate()) AS dev_step_nm FROM scm12_dev_step_rule ORDER BY scm12_dev_step_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm11_dev_step (scm11_dev_step_id, scm11_dev_id, scm11_dev_step_seq, scm11_dev_step_cd, scm11_person_id) VALUES (#{devStepId}, #{devId}, #{seq}, #{cd}, #{personId})
